scenario.title: 忙不過來時找人幫忙、分工
scenario.context: 「老闆叫我改稿」「我讓他先走」「我請印刷廠重印」——職場上一直在講「誰讓誰做什麼」。make / let / have / get 都是「使役動詞」，強迫、允許、安排、說服，意思差很多，後面的動詞形式也不一樣。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hey Amy, are you busy? I'm completely swamped today.
lines.zh: 嘿 Amy，你忙嗎？我今天完全被淹沒了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Karen made me redo the whole deck because the client changed their mind.
lines.zh: Karen 叫我整份簡報重做，因為客戶改主意了。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Ugh, that's the worst. How can I help?
lines.zh: 唉，最慘的狀況。我可以怎麼幫？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Could you cover for me at the 4 p.m. meeting? Just take notes.
lines.zh: 你可以幫我顧四點的會議嗎？做筆記就好。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sure. I'll have Daniel send you the notes afterward, since he's presenting.
lines.zh: 好。我會請 Daniel 結束後把筆記傳給你，因為他要報告。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thank you! Oh, and do you think Karen would let me push the deadline to Monday?
lines.zh: 謝謝！對了，你覺得 Karen 會讓我把截止日延到週一嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Probably, if you get the client to agree first.
lines.zh: 應該會，如果你先說服客戶同意的話。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Minz, sorry to bug you. Are you slammed right now?
lines.zh: Minz，抱歉打擾。你現在超忙嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Not anymore. The deck's done. What's up?
lines.zh: 不忙了，簡報做完了。怎麼了？

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: The printer messed up our business cards. I need to get them reprinted by Thursday.
lines.zh: 印刷廠把我們的名片印壞了，我得讓他們在週四前重印。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know the owner. Let me call him. I'll get him to put us first in line.
lines.zh: 我認識老闆，我打給他。我會讓他把我們排第一。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Of course. You helped me yesterday. I've got your back.
lines.zh: 當然。你昨天幫了我，我挺你。

patterns.en: Could you cover for me at ___?
I'll have ___ send it to you.
I'll get it done by Friday.
Let me know if you need anything.

chinglish.wrong: My boss let me to redo the deck.
chinglish.right: My boss made me redo the deck.
chinglish.why: 兩個錯：let 是「允許」，被迫要用 make；而且 make / let 後面接原形動詞，不加 to。

chinglish.wrong: I will let the printer reprint it.
chinglish.right: I'll have the printer reprint it. / I'll get the printer to reprint it.
chinglish.why: 中文「讓印刷廠重印」的「讓」是「安排」，不是「允許」。安排別人做事用 have 或 get。

chinglish.wrong: Can you help me to cover the meeting?
chinglish.right: Can you cover the meeting for me?
chinglish.why: help me to 雖然文法沒錯，但工作請託直接說要對方做什麼比較簡潔。
疊字不是英文的加強方式，用程度更強的字。

grammar.title: 使役動詞 make / let / have / get
grammar.oneLiner: make 是強迫、let 是允許、have 是安排、get 是說服；make / let / have 接原形，get 接 to V。
whenToUse: make + 人 + 原形：強迫、讓對方不得不做。She made me redo it.
let + 人 + 原形：允許。Let me handle it. / He let us leave early.
have + 人 + 原形：安排、指派（通常是對方本來就該做的）。I'll have Daniel send the notes.
get + 人 + to V：說服、想辦法讓對方做。I got the client to agree.
have / get + 物 + p.p.：請別人把某事做好。I need to get the cards reprinted. / I had my hair cut.
被動的 make：I was made to wait（我被迫等），這時要加 to。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文一個「讓」（或「叫」「請」）就包辦了強迫、允許、安排、說服：「老闆叫我重做」「老闆讓我先走」「我請同事幫忙」。英文要先判斷權力關係和意願，再選動詞。而且 make / let / have 後面不能加 to，這點跟一般動詞不同，台灣人很容易順手寫成 let me to。

examples.correct: Let me help you with that.
examples.incorrect: Let me to help you with that.

examples.correct: The client made us change the color three times.
I'll have my assistant email you the contract.
I finally got my boss to approve the budget.
examples.incorrect: I finally got my boss approve the budget.

examples.correct: I need to get my laptop fixed.
examples.note: get + 物 + p.p.：請人把東西修好。

quiz.question: My manager ___ me leave early because I was sick.
I finally got the client ___ (sign) the contract.
I'll ___ my assistant send you the files.
quiz.explanation: 安排屬下做事用 have + 原形。

quiz.question: I need to get my phone ___ (repair).

slang.usage: cover for someone = 代替某人做事，也可能是幫人掩飾（例如幫翹班的同事圓謊）。

risk.note: 代班的意思完全安全；掩護的意思要看語境。

examples.en: Can you cover for me on Friday? I have a doctor's appointment.
examples.zh: 週五你可以幫我代班嗎？我要看醫生。

examples.en: I'm not going to cover for you if the boss asks.
examples.zh: 老闆問的話，我不會幫你掩護。

slang.usage: I'm swamped (with work). 像被沼澤淹沒一樣。

risk.note: 職場很常用，跟主管說也可以。

examples.en: Sorry, I'm swamped this week. Can we meet next Tuesday?
examples.zh: 抱歉我這週超忙，下週二見面好嗎？

examples.en: We've been swamped with orders since the ad went viral.
examples.zh: 廣告爆紅之後我們訂單接到手軟。

slang.usage: 和 swamped 意思相同，餐飲業常說 We're slammed tonight（今晚客滿忙翻）。

examples.en: The restaurant was slammed all night.
I'm slammed until Thursday, but I'm free after that.
examples.zh: 我週四前都超忙，之後就有空。

slang.usage: 表示會支持、保護對方。也可以說 I got you.

risk.note: 溫暖又有力的一句話，朋友同事都能用。

examples.en: Don't worry about the presentation. I've got your back.
Thanks for having my back in the meeting.
